rows.grounds: gerundive of tyaj; modifies liṅgaṃ and pīṭhaṃ

items.question: When gold particles appear in the tested liquids, should the linga and pedestal be rejected?
premises: gold particles in tested liquids indicate defect
defective linga and pedestal are rejectable
items.inference: therefore reject the linga and pedestal
uncertainties: exact threshold of gold particles unspecified
which liquids beyond listed are intended
items.plain_english: If gold particles appear in the tested liquids, the linga and pedestal should be rejected.
